title: In-app update download
notes: On launch, a newer app is downloaded from this PC and the install screen opens.

title: Continue a chat that is not open
notes: Send from the phone into a saved chat even when that chat is not open on the PC, including when Grok Build is not running. A chat that is already open still goes to that window.

title: A notification per running chat
notes: Each chat that is open on the PC gets its own notification. The session name is on top, and the latest line from that chat is underneath. Chats that are closed stay off the shade.

title: Tool buttons are back on the message row
notes: Slash, file, history, attach, and the mic sit on the row again, next to Send. More is gone.

title: Tap the frame, prompt mark, Plan chip, frame follows the PC, More tools
notes: Tap the session name on the message box to rename it. Tap the model line to change the model or the effort. A > sits at the left of the box and turns gold in plan mode. Chats in plan mode show a gold Plan chip on the home list. The frame updates when the PC changes model, effort, or plan. Slash, file, history, attach, and mic sit behind More.

title: Session name and model on the chat frame
notes: The message box shows the session name at the top right and Grok 4.7 (high) at the bottom right. Plan mode adds · plan and turns the frame gold.

title: Scroll to the failure, Today, plan on the chip, queue per chat, note on the lock screen
notes: Opening a chat jumps to the latest failed step when there is one. Today hides turns from before midnight, and Show week brings them back. The live chip says Plan is ready or Permission needed and a tap shows that bar. A message queued on the phone stays with that chat. The private note shows on the lock-screen card.

title: Open working chat, problems stay open, copy a turn, note on the home row, model on the chip
notes: Opening the app goes to the chat that is running when one is. With Problems on, a turn that failed starts expanded. Long-press a steps line to copy the step names and the reply. The private note shows under that chat on the home list. The live chip starts with the model, such as 4.7 · Evaluate Script.

title: One row per turn, live chip, problems, screen awake, private note
notes: Finished work collapses to a line such as 14 steps · 2m, and the reply stays visible. Tap the line to open those diamonds. The current turn stays open. A chip under the header shows the live step and jumps to it. Problems hides steps that succeeded. The screen stays on while a turn is running. A private note on the chat is stored on the phone and is never sent.

title: Fold repeats, tool times, open working chat, search diamonds, speak the step
notes: The same tool in a row folds into one diamond, such as Chrome-devtools Evaluate Script × 4. A finished tool shows how long it ran. The home screen has a Working chip that opens the chat that is running. Find in thread matches commands, files, and Chrome tool input. Under Notifications, Speak the step says the short tool name once when it changes.

title: Jump to now, quiet view, headset stop, lock-screen queue, copy a diamond
notes: Now scrolls to the live row. Quiet hides the diamond list and leaves your messages and Grok's replies. The headset button stops a running turn and dictates when the chat is idle. If a message is queued, the lock screen shows Send now and Cancel. Long-press a diamond to copy its command, file, or tool input.

title: Tighter diamonds and plain English tool names
notes: Stacked diamond rows sit closer together. Chrome and other tools use the same wording as the PC, such as Chrome-devtools Evaluate Script. Reads, searches, and MCP searches group as Read N files, Searched N patterns, Searched N MCP tools. While one of those tools is running, the status line says Run (Chrome-devtools) Evaluate Script.

title: Every diamond row expands
notes: Thoughts, Run lines, Task started and completed, Searched, Ran command, and tool rows such as Chrome-devtools each use a diamond. Tap one to open the text, command, or tool input. Finished rows start collapsed.

title: Hear the answer, undo send, lock-screen Stop, share a photo, Wi-Fi outbox
notes: After a headset dictation, the finished reply is read aloud. For a few seconds after Send, Undo puts the text back if Grok has not started. The lock screen card has Stop while a turn is running. A photo shared from another app attaches to the open chat. If Wi-Fi drops, the message is kept and sent when the gateway is back.

title: PC queue shows Send now, edit, and cancel
notes: A message queued on the PC shows on the phone as #1 with the text. Send now runs it next, edit puts it back in the composer, and cancel drops it.

title: Collapsing an edit keeps later edits collapsed
notes: Tap an Edit diamond to collapse it, and the edits that follow stay collapsed too. Tap one open again and the edits after that one open. Edits above the one you tapped stay as they were.

title: Lock screen glance and headset dictate
notes: The lock screen shows the chat name, whether it needs you or is working, and the last line. Tap it to open that chat. While Grok Remote is on screen, the headset play button dictates into the open chat. Turn that off under Notifications.

title: Last 7 days of chat, pinch to zoom photos
notes: The phone loads only the last 7 days of a chat, so a long session stays fast. Older messages stay on the PC. A photo opens full screen, and a pinch or double-tap zooms it. Drag moves a zoomed photo.

title: Task lines, Compacting, remembered diamonds
notes: A background command shows Task started and Task completed with the same description as the PC. Context 80% full. Compacting... shows in the chat, and the status line says Compacting... while that runs. Collapsing or opening an edit, code block, thought, or grouped row stays that way.

title: Current thought stays open while edits run
notes: The thought you are in stays expanded under Thinking... with the paragraph visible, including while the status line says Writing edit. After the reply starts it collapses to Thought for, and a tap opens that text.

title: Thinking shows the current thoughts
notes: While Grok is thinking, the chat shows Thinking... with the thought text under the diamond. Afterward it collapses to Thought for, and a tap opens that same text. The status line says Writing edit (3)… while edits are in progress.

title: Edit diffs and code blocks show the actual lines
notes: File edits show the code with line numbers, red for removed and green for added, under a diamond you can tap to collapse. Code blocks in a reply do the same, with Copy. Empty spacer rows are gone.

title: Home search reuses an index
notes: Searching chats reads each session once, then keeps that text in memory. Later keystrokes search the index. A chat is reread only after it changes.

title: Empty screens say what to do next
notes: An empty session list, search, folder, command history, or chat now says what happened and offers the next tap, such as Clear search or Start a session.

title: Tool rows match the PC diamonds
notes: Thoughts, tasks, and grouped reads use the same collapse diamond as the PC. A command shows Task started and Task completed. A read shows the file and line range. Edits stay the red and green diff.

title: Finished tools stay one line until you tap
notes: A finished read, search, or command is one short line. Tap it to see the path or command. Failed rows still have Retry. File edits still show the red and green diff.

title: File edits show the red and green diff
notes: An edit on the PC shows in the chat as Edit and the file name, with removed lines in red and added lines in green. Tap the header to collapse it.

title: One chat can notify through quiet hours
notes: Long-press a session and choose Follow through quiet hours. That chat still notifies from 11pm to 7am. Other chats stay quiet. Only one chat can be followed.

title: Code blocks are visible, collapsible, and copyable
notes: Fenced code in a reply opens as its own block, with the language and line count. Tap the header to collapse it. Copy copies just that block.

title: Photos you send show in the chat
notes: A photo you attach shows on your message in the thread. Tap it to see it larger. Close returns to the chat.

title: Chats reopen faster, and Send stays above the keyboard
notes: Opening a chat you just left shows the transcript immediately, then catches up. The message box and Send stay above the keyboard.

title: Search all chats, mute one session, mark phone messages
notes: Home search also looks inside recent chat text and lists matching sessions. Long-press a session to mute it without quiet hours. Plan and edit prompts still notify. Messages you sent from the phone are marked Phone.

title: Read the last reply aloud
notes: Read aloud speaks the latest answer through the phone. Tap it again to stop. Sending or leaving the chat stops it too.

title: Retry on a failed tool
notes: A failed command or edit shows Retry on that row. Tap it to ask the PC to run that step again without retyping it.

title: Where you left off when you reopen a chat
notes: Reopening a chat you have already read shows Where you left off. Tap it to jump to the first new line. The marker clears once you are back at the bottom.

title: Swipe a session to pin, rename, or hide
notes: Swipe a roster row left to reveal Pin, Rename, and Hide. Pin is the first button. Rename opens the name editor. A full swipe no longer hides the session by itself.

title: Queue drag ignores the long-press menu; jump buttons step through history
notes: The queue grip no longer loses the press to the phone's long-press menu. Last message and Last error step backward through every match, then wrap.

title: Drag queued follow-ups to reorder them
notes: Hold the grip on a queued row and drag it among the other PC or app rows. The PC queue order updates on this computer.

title: Suggested next line shows in italics under the reply
notes: After a reply that offers a next step, that suggestion shows in italics at the bottom of the chat. Tap it to put the line in the composer.

title: Jump to the last message or the last error
notes: Inside a chat, Last message scrolls to the latest thing you typed. Last error scrolls to the latest failed tool and opens it if it was folded.

title: Roster shows how many subagents are running
notes: A chat with child agents shows 1 running or 2 running on its roster row. The count drops when those agents finish.

title: Command prompts on the phone, and one notification per real event
notes: Shell commands get the same phone choices as Allow Edit. Pass complete stays quiet while a plan or an edit prompt is still open. The same event does not notify twice.

title: Plan choices sit on the chat while a plan is waiting
notes: While the PC is waiting to exit plan mode, the phone shows Approve, Request changes, and Quit on the chat itself instead of only a spinner.

title: Allow Edit choices can be answered on the phone
notes: When the PC asks Allow Edit, the phone shows the same four choices: always-approve, allow edits this session, Yes, or No with an optional reason. The choice is sent into that PC window.

title: Plan review opens when the PC asks for approval
notes: Starting plan mode no longer leaves the phone sitting on Planning. When the PC asks you to approve the plan, the phone opens it and sends Plan ready.

title: Weekly usage bar stays on the home screen
notes: The SuperGrok weekly bar stays pinned under the session list instead of scrolling away with it. The percent in the title bar is the same meter.

title: Plan review on the phone, and Landed on PC when a send arrives
notes: When this PC is waiting on a plan, the phone opens the plan and notifies Plan ready. Approve, Revise, and Quit are sent into that window. Pass complete waits until the plan is no longer waiting. A send notifies Landed on PC only after it is in the session, or says Queued on PC if the window is busy.

title: Usage shows this session’s context window
notes: Tap Usage in a chat to see this session’s window: system, tools, messages, and free space. That is separate from the weekly SuperGrok bar on the home screen.

title: Model picker includes Grok 4.7 and 4.7 Fast
notes: The model list now offers grok-4.7 (the PC default) and grok-4.7-build-fast. Fast is the same model on faster hardware, billed at twice the token rate.

title: Pass complete waits until the turn actually finishes
notes: A pause while Grok is thinking or running a tool no longer fires Pass complete. That notification waits until the turn recap is written.

title: Needs you only when Grok is actually waiting on you
notes: The Needs you filter is hidden unless a session is waiting for a decision. An open PC session is labeled On PC, not Needs you.

title: Home-screen widget, quiet hours, reply from a notification
notes: Add a Grok Remote widget to the home screen for the live session, working vs needs-you, and the last line. Tap it to open that chat. Quiet hours (11pm–7am) skip pass-complete banners; approvals still notify. Reply on a notification sends into that session.

title: Phone send types into this PC window
notes: A send from the phone is typed into the live Grok window on this PC. It no longer starts a second hidden Grok on the same session, which is why Test test answered on the phone but did not appear here.

title: Phone turns finish without reopening the PC
notes: A send from the phone no longer opens a second Grok on the same session, which was killing the turn before it finished. The app now follows the live session log until the reply completes, and shows Queued on PC when this desktop turn is still running.

title: Weekly usage on the home screen
notes: Title bar shows your live SuperGrok weekly used percent. The home screen has the same product bar as grok.com Settings → Usage (Build / Chat / Imagine / API / Voice) plus the reset time.

title: Phone send survives a closed WebSocket
notes: Send from the phone uses HTTP on the PC and landed in this live session while Grok was already working. The ACP bridge stays up instead of crashing on health probes.

title: Phone WebSocket send stays open
notes: The ACP socket no longer closes on send. A WebSocket e2e send of [Grok Remote] e2e ws landed in this live session.

title: Restore phone send into the live TUI
notes: Phone sends use Grok agent stdio resume of the open session, which this PC already proved by injecting a [Grok Remote] line into the live thread.

title: Stop hanging sends; require PC echo
notes: A phone send no longer waits forever. If the live PC session does not actually take the message, the app reports that instead of spinning.

title: Phone send types into the live TUI
notes: A send from the phone is typed into the live PC Grok window (same session PID), so it shows on screen like you typed it.

title: Fix send WebSocket closed
notes: Phone send no longer kills grok by passing a Windows named pipe as a file. The user ACP bridge stays up so messages can join the live TUI.

title: Join the live TUI leader for phone sends
notes: Phone sends now attach to the PC's live Grok leader (user ACP bridge + named pipe). Messages should show in the TUI thread, not a hidden copy of the session.

title: Phone sends show on the PC
notes: Messages sent from the phone go through the live TUI session so they appear on the PC, not a side connection. PC and app turns stay bidirectional.

title: Edit permission card on the phone
notes: When Grok asks Allow Edit (or a command), the phone shows the same choices as the PC: always-approve, allow all edits this session, Yes, or No with optional feedback. The card is not swallowed while history loads.

title: Working strip, drafts, status glance
notes: Roster shows a strip of sessions that are working or need you. Composer drafts survive leaving a chat. The silent status-bar line shows how many need you vs working.

title: Roster long-press menu on the list
notes: Hold a session on the roster and the options sheet now appears there. It no longer waits until you open the chat. Tap outside or Cancel to dismiss; the hold no longer opens the session.

title: Long-press rename and session actions
notes: Hold a session in the roster to rename it (that press no longer cancels if your finger moves a little). Same menu: pin, hide, fork, session info, copy name, stop if running, delete. Auto title is on the rename sheet.

title: No leftover notifications on open
notes: Opening the app after it was closed clears old approval/done banners and does not replay leftover events. Only notifications that happen after launch are shown.

title: Restart gateway without UAC
notes: I can bounce the LAN gateway myself: POST /api/admin/restart with the pairing secret, or the GrokRemoteRestart scheduled task. No UAC prompt after the one-time register.

title: Bulletproof gateway, memory, reconnect
notes: Gateway survives crashes: node restart loop, 1-minute health watchdog, ACP retries, and it no longer dies on uncaught errors. The phone reconnects with backoff when Wi-Fi or the PC drops. Permission sheets label Always/Never allow. Memory is GA: /remember, /memory, /flush, /recap.

title: Notify Open Allow Stop, Needs you
notes: Approval notifications have Open, Allow, and Stop, and vibrate. Needs-you sessions sort first; the roster has a Needs you filter. Search matches name, last turn, folder, and id.

title: Fork, share, session info
notes: Fork confirms then opens the new session. /export and long-press Share send the last reply or whole thread. Session info shows prompts, compactions, duration, and tools used.

title: Rewind, compact, long-press
notes: Rewind opens a turn picker. Usage at 80%+ offers Compact with an optional keep-note. Long-press a reply to Copy, Quote, or Retry. Multiple-choice questions from Grok show as a sheet.

title: Mobile commands in history
notes: Clock / recent-commands list includes prompts sent from the phone, tagged App. Those prompts are also written to Grok Build command history so they show on the PC too.

title: Collapse Execute and Writes
notes: Execute and Write tool stacks collapse like Reads. Tap to expand; they stay open while running.

title: Half-screen @ file picker
notes: The @ file list is a half-screen scrollable popup like / and history. It no longer fills the screen or opens the keyboard.

title: PC queue on the phone
notes: The session queue on the PC shows on the phone with Start and Cancel. App-queued follow-ups appear in the same list.

title: Cleaner notification icon
notes: Status-bar and notification mark is a simple Grok C with slash. Remote arcs are gone so it reads at small size.

title: Notify on PC UAC prompt
notes: The phone gets a notification when Windows shows a UAC administrator prompt on this PC.

title: Outside-tap menus, clock and paperclip
notes: / @ and history menus close when you tap outside. History is a clock; attach is a paperclip.

title: Send no longer waits on the whole turn
notes: The phone gets an immediate OK when a message is handed to Grok. The reply still streams live. Failed to fetch no longer kicks off a stuck Connecting state if the PC is still reachable.

title: Line mic icon, chat name in header
notes: Mic is a B&W silhouette matching the other tools. In a session the header shows the chat name with connection status underneath.

title: Send via gateway, no load hang
notes: Session history loads from disk without waiting on ACP. Sends go through the PC gateway. Grok agent now uses GROK_HOME so it sees the signed-in TUI. Opening a session no longer hangs on Writing after ws closed.

title: Skip broken ACP login
notes: Phone no longer calls authenticate with cached_token when Grok only offers grok.com and the PC TUI is already signed in. That was Authentication cancelled / Authentication required.

title: Fix Authentication cancelled
notes: Stop the background sidecar from fighting the phone login. Authenticate retries instead of failing on the first cancel.

title: Show hidden, pass-complete notify
notes: Show hidden is a full-width button on the session list. Pass-complete notifications fire when a chat finishes, including from disk activity if you are not looking at that session.

title: Swipe to hide, star in the row
notes: Hide is a swipe-left action on a session. The star sits on the right inside the card, not as a separate button.

title: Pull to refresh, no plan prompt on history
notes: Pull down on the session list to refresh and reconnect. Opening a session no longer pops plan approval from old history; that sheet only appears after a new request, or if you tap Plan.

title: Pin, hide, splash versions
notes: Star/pin sessions to the top and hide others from the list (Show hidden to bring them back). Connect splash shows App version and the Grok Build version on this PC.

title: Fewer, clearer notifications
notes: Alerts only for approval needed, a real problem, or pass complete, with session context. Status-bar icon is a thicker Grok Remote mark. No ping while you are already looking at that session.

title: Fix garbled composer icons
notes: UTF-8 icons and punctuation were corrupted by the last publish. Mic, plus, arrows, and ellipsis are restored.

title: Plan green, Auto default
notes: Plan is green; Auto is grey/system and the default. Ask blue, Approve red.

title: Bigger prompt, mode colors
notes: Composer tools sit on their own row so the message box is full width.
Prompt border and text follow mode: Ask blue, Plan magenta, Auto amber, Approve red — toggles under the box.

title: Working Android mic
notes: 🎤 opens the phone’s speech-to-text dialog (asks for microphone permission) and pastes into the prompt without sending.

title: Phone is a plan-approval client
notes: The app no longer authenticates as headless, so Grok can send plan approval to the phone.
Approve answers x.ai/exit_plan_mode (approved / rejected / abandoned) instead of leaving the RPC unanswered.

title: Plan Approve does not hang
notes: Approve closes the plan sheet immediately and answers the permission. It no longer waits on /plan, which deadlocked with Grok still waiting for approval.

title: Grok Remote notification icon
notes: Needs-you, turn-complete, and the keep-alive notice use the Grok Remote logo instead of a generic Android icon.

title: Voice, camera, find
notes: Mic on the composer dictates into the box and does not send.
＋ offers Take photo or Photo library (clipboard paste still works).
⌕ finds text in the thread; ↑ ↓ jumps between hits.

title: Phone Approve and /plan actually work
notes: Slash commands like /plan are no longer rewritten to [Grok Remote] /plan.
Approve sends /plan and waits until plan mode ends instead of only closing the overlay.

title: Plan approval on the phone
notes: exit_plan_mode opens a scrollable plan preview instead of silently exiting.
Approve, Request changes, or Quit — same idea as the PC TUI.
Tap the Plan chip to reopen the current plan.md.

title: Scrollable changelog
notes: Settings and the changelog list scroll with your finger instead of getting cut off.

title: Don't yank the thread while thinking
notes: Scrolling up while Grok is working no longer snaps you back to the bottom.
A ↓ button appears when you're not at the latest; tap it to jump down.

title: @ search, last session, copy
notes: @ file picker has search; typing @name in the prompt suggests files.
The app reopens the last session you were in.
Copy on each Grok reply copies the markdown.

title: @ files, notify actions, biometrics
notes: @ opens a file browser for the session folder and inserts @path into the prompt.
Needs-you notifications include Open and Allow.
Fingerprint / face unlock when a PIN is set (installed APK).

title: PIN, blocking permissions, LAN notify
notes: Optional 4–8 digit PIN locks the app when you leave it.
Permission prompts block the composer until you choose Allow or Reject.
Needs-you and turn-complete fire local notifications; tapping opens the session.
A quiet foreground notification keeps the LAN socket alive in the background.

title: Usage, todos, slash, roster edit
notes: Usage chip shows context percent; tap for model, tokens, turns.
Todos chip lists the current plan (tap a group to expand).
/ compact, rewind, and fork run from the slash palette (with confirm).
Long-press a session to rename or delete (live PC sessions stay protected).

title: Mode chips, grouped tools, queue, images
notes: Ask / Plan / Auto / Approve, model, and effort chips apply to the live PC session.
Consecutive reads/searches/edits collapse to “Read 9 files” (tap to expand).
Send while Grok is working queues a follow-up; Send now interrupts like the TUI.
＋ attaches a photo; paste from clipboard also works.

title: Chat stays put when you swipe
notes: Swiping left or right on the thread no longer slides the whole chat.
Long tool lines and paths wrap instead of making a phantom page to the right.

title: Reply formatting matches Grok Build
notes: Grok replies render as markdown (bold, lists, links) instead of mashed raw text.
Each reply shows the time and Worked for duration, like the PC card.
Streaming no longer drops spaces and punctuation.

title: Thinking, status timer, command history
notes: Thinking stays expanded with Grok Build formatting (Thought for Xs, paragraph text).
Live spinner shows Waiting / Thinking / Writing / edit (and the current tool) with a timer, plus Stop.
Tools stay one-line — no file contents or code scrolling in the thread.
↑ command history lists PC and App prompts; tapping pastes into the box without sending.

title: Live thread + waiting
notes: PC typing and Grok turns stream into the open thread — no close/reopen.
Send shows Waiting / Thinking immediately so you can tell it went through.
Thinking stays open as it streams, like Grok Build.

title: In-app sessions, full history, working back
notes: APK no longer jumps to the phone browser after Connect — UI stays in the app.
Opening a session loads the full Grok Build thread (user, Grok, tools, thoughts) from disk, then attaches live.
Android back and the in-app back button return to the session list instead of leaving the app.

title: Send, scroll, icon, honest updates
notes: Sending a message reattaches the session if the socket dropped instead of doing nothing.
Keepalive every 20s and auto-reconnect without tapping Reconnect.
Update banner only if the APK version is actually older (0.1.1 no longer nagged itself).
Thread view locks height and jumps to the latest message like Grok.
App icon: Grok slash with remote signal flair.

title: APK uses the real LAN page
notes: Android WebView no longer iframes the UI (that blocked WebSockets).
App navigates to the LAN gateway like the working PC browser.
Cleartext HTTP scheme so LAN fetch is not mixed-content.
Connect screen probes the LAN first and shows scan errors.

title: First LAN remote client
notes: Session roster from live Grok Build ACP (session/list).
Open a session, replay history, send prompts, stream replies and tool cards.
Permission prompts, cancel turn, and new session from the phone.
LAN-only gateway on port 2420; Grok ACP on 2419.
In-app APK update banner with changelog and download from this server.
Local notifications when a session needs you (while the app is connected).
